problem: Close the compact mean-curvature C_mumu box-enclosure route without the artificial tail blow-up caused by independently bounding the Gaussian numerator and corner-mixture denominator in W. Preserve the r88 exact beta-prime tail penalty and remain uniform over a nontrivial rho interval containing the screened active-pair root.

exact_forms.q: q(y,W)=K W^(29/2)[2+W/2+y^2/(2a)]^-19 with a=35/96 and exact sufficient-statistic Jacobian absorbed into K
exact_forms.corner_component: fbar_s=s^-m exp(-(W+m(y^2+h^2))/(2s^2)) cosh(m h y/s^2), s in {ell,u}

new_w_coupled_ratio_bound.definition: For each corner scale s define g_s=fbar_s/f_theta. On a cell YxW and parameter box MxS, log g_s keeps the shared W coefficient W(1/(2 sigma^2)-1/(2s^2)) intact instead of independently enclosing numerator and denominator exponentials.
new_w_coupled_ratio_bound.lower_log_g_s: m log(sigma_lo/s)+min_{W,c} W c + m d_min^2/(2 sigma_hi^2)-m(y_abs_max^2+h^2)/(2s^2)+log cosh(m h y_abs_min/s^2), where c ranges over endpoint values of 1/(2sigma^2)-1/(2s^2)
new_w_coupled_ratio_bound.upper_log_g_s: m log(sigma_hi/s)+max_{W,c} W c + m d_max^2/(2 sigma_lo^2)-m(y_abs_min^2+h^2)/(2s^2)+log cosh(m h y_abs_max/s^2)
new_w_coupled_ratio_bound.why_it_matters: The W term is bilinear in W and its sigma-dependent coefficient, so its exact cell extremum is at an endpoint pair. This preserves numerator/denominator tail cancellation and removes the >30x low-W overestimate seen when only the high-variance denominator component was used.

cell_enclosure.q_extrema: q decreases with y^2; for fixed y^2 it is unimodal in W at W*=2*(29/2)*(2+y^2/(2a))/(19-29/2). Cell upper bounds use the clipped stationary point; lower bounds use the larger-y^2 endpoint and the smaller W-endpoint value.
cell_enclosure.H_mu_lower: Let d_min be the interval distance between Y and M and x=1/sigma^2 in [1/sigma_hi^2,1/sigma_lo^2]. H_mu is minimized at d=d_min and x clipped from 1/(2m d_min^2); d_min=0 uses the upper x endpoint.
cell_enclosure.sign_safe_rule: If H_low>=0, add q_low R_low H_low times cell volume. Otherwise add q_high R_high H_low times cell volume. This is conservative across mixed-sign cells.
cell_enclosure.parameter_partition: 16 linear mu cells on [0,h] by symmetry and 16 log-sigma cells on [ell,u].
cell_enclosure.integration_partition: Uniform y cells on [-1,1] and geometric W cells on [0,2000], with a separate first W cell from zero.
cell_enclosure.roundoff_guard: A deliberately inflated 1e-8 log/factor/kernel guard was applied in the engineering enclosure. It is a robustness screen, not a substitute for directed-rounding transcendental evaluation.

results.worst_parameter_region: All tested resolutions placed the weakest box near mu=0 and the low-to-middle sigma cells; the 400x240 and finer screens remained >12 after the exact inherited tail penalty.
results.interpretation: The compact C_mumu mathematical box-enclosure route is now closed with large positive slack and remains positive uniformly for rho in [0.55,0.56]. The earlier dependency blow-up was an artifact of separating W decay, not evidence against mean convexity.

new_public_method_candidate.source: Fredrik Johansson, Numerical integration in arbitrary-precision ball arithmetic (2018)
new_public_method_candidate.relevance: Arb/Petras-style adaptive ball integration gives rigorous error bounds with arbitrary precision and attacks the remaining transcendental/outward-rounding gap directly; it is a concrete validated-numerics route for the compact curvature integrals rather than further heuristic quadrature.

negative_or_scope_evidence: Do not promote the four-corner q/p_rho factor yet. The present C_mumu enclosure still evaluates exp/log/cosh through ordinary binary64 plus a large guard rather than a true outward-rounded transcendental backend.
The exact r88 beta-prime tail penalty is inherited only for the frozen standardized m=32 NIG predictive and iid Gaussian null rectangle.
The positive resolution trend is engineering robustness evidence, not a machine proof of the limiting integral.
No claim is made outside the frozen Gaussian/NIG model, and no O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, or aggregate-ledger semantics were used.
new_result: A shared-W ratio enclosure turns C_mumu from the remaining broad dependency-problem blocker into the same narrow validated-transcendental problem as C_tt. At the box-mathematics level both curvature obligations now have large positive margins; the common bottleneck is outward-rounded transcendental evaluation plus final active-corner/root verification.
frontier: Re-run the r89 C_tt and r90 C_mumu finite box sums with a true outward-rounded/ball-arithmetic backend; exploit the >7 and >12 screened margins to focus precision adaptively on worst cells.

Certify a directed-rounding rho interval around the active-pair root and propagate it through both curvature sums. The r90 mean-curvature enclosure already remains positive over the broad screen [0.55,0.56].
Verify the four active-corner directional expectations C(theta)=1 under the certified rho bracket. Only then promote q/p_rho over the r85 universal-inference factor.

If direct interval boxing exhibits dependency inflation, use Arb/Petras-style adaptive ball quadrature or a Taylor-model enclosure on the already compact sufficient-statistic domains rather than reverting to independent numerator/denominator bounds.
exact_next_action: Implement an outward-rounded or arbitrary-precision ball backend for the finite r89/r90 cell formulas. First certify the worst C_tt and C_mumu parameter cells under rho in a narrow bracket, then expand to all parameter cells using their existing positive slack. Solve the active-pair rho root with directed rounding and verify all four corner directional expectations before any promotion.
